थण्डिल: thaṇḍila (= Pali id., MIndic for Skt. stha°), see sthaṇḍila-śāyikā.
थपकर्णि: Thapakarṇi(n), and °ṇika (semi-MIndic for Stha°), see s.v. Sthapakarṇi(ka).
थपयति: thapayati, thapeti (Pali only thap°), see s.v. stha-payati.
थरथरायते: tharatharāyate, onomat., pres. p. °yamāna (AMg. tharatharai, °ranta, ppp. tharahariya; Pkt. °tharāamāṇa, Sheth), trembling: atha balir asurendro 'dhomukhaṃ pra-patitaḥ, smṛtibhraṣṭa-tharatharāyamānaḥ sthitaḥ Kv 33.24; bhītās trastāḥ °āyamānāḥ Mmk 182.17; °āyamānāḥ pīḍyamānāś ca vepathu-r-upajātaśaṅkā Mmk 520.17. (n, not ṇ, always written.)
थरु: tharu (= Pali id.; § 2.9), hilt of a sword; sword: (dha-nusmiṃ vā) tharusmiṃ vā Mv ii.74.3; in Mv iii.366.2 (vs) read tharu-khaḍga-pāṇi, for text tara°, with Pali Jāt. v. 136.24 tharu-khagga-baddhā.
थल: thala (nt., = Pali id., MIndic for Skt. sthala), dry land: Mv iii.32.2,11 (v.l. sthala in both: prose).
थवन: thavana, nt., a high number: Mvy 7855 (cited from Gv); Gv 133.8.
थाम: thāma (= Pali id., see sthāma-n), fortitude: LV 127.19 thakāre thāma…śabdaḥ, in the spelling-lesson.
थीन: thīna, nt. (= Pali id.), MIndic for styāna (§§ 2.12; 3.115; also stīna): °naṃ (n. sg.) Mv iii.284.5
थुत्थु: thutthu (-kārakam, adv.), (making) the sound thutthu (in eating): na…Mvy 8579 = Tib. hu hu (the sound of one's mouth in eating) mi bya. Cf. Skt. Lex. thū-thū, said to be imitative of spitting; Skt. thūtkāra, and the like. Chin. onomat., indicating that one has eaten something hot.
थेर: thera, m. (= Pali id. cf. sthera; MIndic for Skt. stha-vira, which has this mg.), old man (decrepit; not in religious sense): Mv iii.4.17 (vs).
